title: Move CI to larger runners
description: Builds took 22 minutes and slowed everyone down.

comments.author: Aisha Khan
comments.body: Moved to runners with eight cores. Build time dropped from 22 to 9 minutes.

comments.author: Aisha Khan
comments.body: We rejected only adding more caching because most of the time was spent compiling, which caching does not help.

comments.author: Aisha Khan
comments.body: Gotcha: the dependency cache key must include the lockfile hash, otherwise stale packages are reused and builds pass locally but fail in production.
